fun_fact: Earlier this week, we celebrated Owl Awareness Day. Did you know India has almost 35 species of owls? They provide a pivotal ecological service by controlling agricultural pests — feeding on rodents, shrews, and small insects — and sit at the apex of trophic levels in terrestrial and aquatic ecosystems. Learn more about owls in India [here](https://www.pugdundeesafaris.com/blog/owls-in-india/).
